description:
[Original Webtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/zjffjful)

"You've been staring at me for a while now. Do you like me?"

Noah Hewer appears before Song Yu-jin, who longed for a normal life.

To Yujin, everything—taking classes with Noah, living in the same house, working on group projects together, and hanging out with friends—feels like a miracle.

You, who helped me find the colors I lost in this world. In this land that is familiar to me but unfamiliar to you, we met again, though you may not know it.
